content.value: Write regular expression/definition for the following languages:
(i) The set of all strings of 0's and 1’s such that no prefix has two more 0's than $1 ^ { \bullet } \mathfrak { s } ,$ not two more 1's than 0's.
(ii) The set of all strings of 0's and 1’s whose no. of 0’s is dvisible by 5 and no. of 1’s is even.
(iii) The set of all strings of 0's and 1’s whose $1 0 ^ { \mathfrak { t h } }$ symbol from the right end is 1.
(iv) The set of all strings of 0’s and 1’s such that every pair of adjacent 0’s appears before any pair of adjacent 1’s.
